title: Victim identification and care in psychiatric outpatient clinics
summary:
Natürlich — hier ist dein Text **präzise und fachsprachlich korrekt ins Englische übersetzt**, im passenden Stil für ein wissenschaftliches Poster oder eine Background:
- Increased risk of experiencing interpersonal violence among individuals with mental disorders
- Forms of violence: sexual, domestic, institutional, and perpetrator-based violence
- Lack of professional confidence and insufficient structural integration despite existing guidelines (e.g., DGRM) and training programs
Objective:
Conduct a needs assessment to improve the care of psychiatric patients affected by interpersonal violence
Methodology:
- Mixed-methods approach** (quantitative & qualitative)
- Surveys with patients of the Institute Outpatient Clinic in Mettmann and healthcare professionals from several LVR outpatient clinics
- Assessment of prevalence, risk factors, institutional response, existing SOPs, training, and barriers to adequate care
Research Questions:
- How frequently do psychiatric patients experience interpersonal violence?
- Which risk and protective factors can be identified?
- How well is healthcare staff prepared to care for patients affected by violence?
- What structural and individual barriers hinder adequate care?

interventions.name: Patients of the Institute Outpatient Clinic in Mettmann , aged 18 years and older are asked to complete structured questionnaires to collect data on experiences of violence and sociodemographic information. Period: January 2026 to June 2026

Medical doctors, nursing staff, medical assistants, psychologists, and psychotherapists working in one of the institute outpatient clinics of LVR Langenfeld are asked to complete structured questionnaires on dealing with victims of violence and on sociodemographic data. Period: January 2026 to March

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inclusion Criteria – Patients: Patients of the Institute Outpatient Clinic in Mettmann, Department of General Psychiatry II, aged 18 years or older
Inclusion Criteria – Medical Personnel:
Physicians, nursing staff, medical assistants, psychologists, and psychotherapists, employed in one of the institute outpatient clinics of LVR Langenfeld and reachable via email.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion Criteria – Patients:
Intellectual disability
Language barrier
Lack of legal capacity
Acute inability to self-regulate (e.g., due to substance intoxication or acute psychosis)
